question: Shanmukh starts from a bank and walks 90 m towards south. Then she turns right, and walks 110 m. Then she turns right, and walks 90 m. Finally she turns right again, and walks 220 m. In which direction is she now relative to the bank? (All the turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given: 

Shanmukh starts from a bank and walks 90 m towards south.

Then she turns right, and walks 110 m. 

Then she turns right, and walks 90 m. 

Finally she turns right again, and walks 220 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd2bad446eae82eb3c3510c749d0039dc64b2c5b9df165b0e3913cacfeb6bc5a.png] 

So, Shanmukh is facing towards the East direction relative to bank.

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
